type: Lockstitch / flat sewing machine electronic control box

specs.errorClearMethod: Press + to re-detect and clear error alarm (E4, E5, shutdown reminder only)

errorCodes.cause: Machine has not been running for about 30 minutes and enters sleep state, OR supply voltage is too low
errorCodes.solution: Press + or - key to wake up the machine. If alarm cannot be eliminated, check whether the power supply voltage is normal.

errorCodes.cause: Motor stuck — machine head is stuck or dry and difficult to rotate, motor plug is loose or has fallen off, materials are too thick and motor cannot penetrate due to insufficient torque
errorCodes.solution: Rotate the hand wheel to check whether the machine head is stuck or dry and difficult to rotate. Check whether the motor plug-in is loose or falls off. Check whether the materials are too thick and the motor cannot penetrate due to insufficient torque.

errorCodes.cause: Controller exception — motor load too large, sewing material too thick, machine lacks lubrication
errorCodes.solution: Turn off and power on again. If alarm cannot be eliminated: reduce load and restart motor if load is too large; check if sewing material is too thick; check if machine lacks lubrication. If above problems cannot be solved, contact maintenance personnel.

errorCodes.cause: Abnormal motor Hall signal — motor encoder plug connection is unreliable, encoder signal wire is broken, or pin has deformed
errorCodes.solution: Check whether the motor encoder plug connection is reliable, whether the encoder signal wire is broken, and whether the pin exits or deforms. Press + to re-detect and clear if alarm is gone.

errorCodes.cause: Abnormal locator signal — encoder/positioner plug connection unreliable, abnormal Hall of motor positioner, or positioner is damaged
errorCodes.solution: Turn the hand wheel. If alarm persists, turn off power and on again. Check if encoder/positioner plug connection is reliable. Abnormal Hall of motor positioner — if positioner is damaged or positioning function is not required, long press - for 3S to close the needle stop function and release alarm. Press + to re-detect if alarm can be cleared.

errorCodes.cause: Abnormal speed controller — speed controller type does not match parameter b setting, speed controller plug is loose or has fallen off, or speed controller signal is abnormal
errorCodes.solution: If E6 is flashing: check if speed controller type matches parameter b (default b=0 for computerized lockstitch type). Adjust b parameter to match current speed controller. If E6 is always on: check whether speed controller is inserted and plug/pin is not loose or fallen off. If alarm cannot be eliminated, replace the governor. If still cannot be eliminated, control box speed controller signal may be abnormal — contact maintenance personnel.

errorCodes.cause: Head safety switch alarm — head safety switch is turned on and machine head has tilted/dumped
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the safety switch or restore the head position. If alarm cannot be eliminated, contact maintenance personnel. Long press - for 3S to close the safety switch alarm function and release alarm.
Turn off the power and power on again. If alarm cannot be eliminated, contact maintenance personnel.

errorCodes.cause: System overvoltage — power supply voltage exceeds 294V (220V control box) or 147V (110V control box)
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the power supply immediately and check whether the power supply voltage exceeds threshold. Adjust power supply voltage to rated voltage before starting the machine (220V box rated: 220V; 110V box rated: 110V).

errorCodes.cause: System undervoltage — power supply voltage is lower than 110V (220V control box) or 55V (110V control box)
errorCodes.solution: Immediately cut off the power supply and check whether power supply voltage is below threshold. Adjust power supply voltage to rated voltage before starting the machine (220V box rated: 220V; 110V box rated: 110V).

errorCodes.cause: Current detection circuit fault — circuit board dirty, power supply voltage abnormal, or power board malfunction
errorCodes.solution: Check whether the circuit board is clean. Check whether power supply voltage is normal. Wait for power to be turned on/reset again (carefully check functions of power board).

errorCodes.cause: Complementary stitch button failure — machine head complementary stitch button is stuck in the off position
errorCodes.solution: Check whether the complementary stitch button of the machine head can turn on and off normally. If it keeps off, replace the button of the machine head. The alarm automatically turns off the complementary stitch function but will not affect motor operation. Alarm will be cleared automatically after 30s or by pressing +.

parameters.name: Max sewing speed
parameters.note: Increase/decrease by 500rpm per step. Value 40 = 4000 RPM.

parameters.name: Dormancy time
parameters.note: 0 = Off (no sleep). Value 3 = 30 minutes idle before sleep.

parameters.name: Acceleration
parameters.note: The higher the value, the faster the acceleration.

parameters.name: Point stitch interval
parameters.note: The larger the value, the larger the point stitch interval.

parameters.name: Speed controller model selection
parameters.note: Must match the actual speed controller installed. Mismatch will cause E6 alarm.

monitoring.name: Pedal voltage monitoring
monitoring.note: Displayed number / 10 = actual pedal voltage value

monitoring.name: Historical error code
monitoring.note: Last 5 errors displayed; 00 = no error. Auto-returns to standby after 8S of no operation.

monitoring.name: Cumulative running time
monitoring.note: Displayed number × 100 = actual time in hours

monitoring.name: Speed controller standby range adjustment
monitoring.note: Displayed number / 10 = actual voltage. Adjusts middle value of voltage for pedal standby state.

troubleshooting.symptom: E6 error flashing on F5 control box
checks: Enter parameter F interface and navigate to parameter 'b'
Check whether b=0 (computerized lockstitch) or b=1 (ZB simple type) matches the actual speed controller fitted
Adjust b to match and save — power off and replace the governor
If E6 is always on (not flashing): check whether the speed controller plug is firmly inserted
If alarm persists after re-seating plug, replace the governor/speed controller
Press + or - button to wake machine from sleep mode
If OF persists, check that power supply voltage is within 220V ±20% range
Check low voltage alarm parameter R — if R is set too high it may trigger a false alarm
If voltage is normal and alarm persists, contact manufacturer

troubleshooting.symptom: E5 abnormal locator signal on F5
checks: Turn the hand wheel to check if encoder signal recovers
Power off and power on again
Check encoder/positioner plug connection at both motor and board ends
If positioner not needed: long press - for 3S to disable needle stop function and clear alarm
If positioner is damaged, replace it

troubleshooting.symptom: E1 motor stuck — machine won't run
checks: Rotate the hand wheel manually — check if machine head is stiff or seized
Check motor plug connection is secure
Check if material is too thick for current torque setting
Oil the machine if it is dry/stiff
If motor plug is OK and head is free, check motor and controller

troubleshooting.symptom: Eb or EC voltage alarm on F5
checks: Turn off power immediately
Check input voltage with a multimeter — 220V box must be 220V ±20% (176V-264V)
Do not restart until voltage is within the rated range
Check if voltage fluctuation from other equipment on the same circuit is causing the spike
Check whether the complementary stitch button on the machine head can toggle on/off normally
Press the button and listen for a clear click — stuck in off position = replace button
The machine will continue to sew normally; complementary stitch function is only disabled
Alarm auto-clears after 30s or press + to clear
